verdict.rationale: Warp's client source is published under AGPL v3 at warpdotdev/warp, so users can audit and build the core terminal client themselves. Cloud agents can also run on 'your own' infrastructure instead of Warp's cloud. However, nothing documents self-hosting the backend services the AI-native experience depends on: AI routing, Warp Drive, accounts and collaboration. Missing for 10: documented self-hosted backend/server deployment, self-host install and ops guides for the full stack, independent or hands-on corroboration of running Warp self-hosted.
